evidence.quote: Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist

observations.why: Universal mandate framing ('Every new hire completes') enacts authority-ranking: a uniform requirement imposed across all newcomers regardless of individual variation.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter.

observations.why: Reporting a substitution of one governance artifact for another carries authority-ranking residue — the new checklist superseded the old page by institutional decision — but the signal is weak and descriptive rather than performative.
